text: {"components": [{"type": "entity", "quote": "Swiss Transportation Safety Investigation Board (STSB)", "gist": "STSB, the Swiss authority for transportation safety investigations"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The Swiss Transportation Safety Investigation Board (STSB) is the State authority of the Swiss Confederation which has a mandate to investigate accidents and dangerous incidents involving trains, aircraft, inland navigation ships, and seagoing vessels.", "gist": "STSB is the Swiss state body responsible for investigating transport accidents and incidents"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The aim of this activity is to determine not only the direct causes of such events but also the more deep-seated reasons and other risks associated with them.", "gist": "The goal is to find both immediate and underlying causes and associated risks of transport incidents"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "This sole objective of this form of investigation is to acquire insights by means of which future accidents and hazardous situations can be prevented and which result in improved safety.", "gist": "The purpose is to gain insights to prevent future accidents and improve safety"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "However, the results of such a safety investigation are not intended to clarify questions of blame and liability.", "gist": "Safety investigations do not determine blame or liability"}]}
